items.summary: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Here is how we addressed the issue.

items.title: Introducing a Voluntary Exit Offer
items.summary: Amy Coleman, Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, shared the below communication with Microsoft employees today. Today, we’re introducing a new Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) to eligible employees within participating organizations. This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with...

items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.summary: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

items.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
items.summary: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

items.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
items.summary: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

items.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
items.summary: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

items.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
items.summary: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

items.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
items.summary: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

items.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
items.summary: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

items.title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
items.summary: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.
